newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: MOTOR RACING-VILLENEUVE QUICKEST IN TESTING.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-VILLENEUVE QUICKEST IN TESTING.

text.p: Jacques Villeneuve was comfortably fastest again on the third day of Formula One testing at Estoril on Thursday.

The Williams driver, who could still ruin Damon Hill's world title hopes in the Japanese Grand Prix on October 13, was the only driver to break the one minute 21 seconds barrier. He clocked a best lap of 1:20.38.
Hill took the day off. Heinz-Harald Frentzen, his successor at Williams, recorded 1:21.93 in his Sauber.
